text: USAID’s Tayar Nepal is a five-year initiative aimed at strengthening Nepal's disaster risk management systems at both national and municipal levels. The project focuses on enhancing institutional capacity, policy reform, risk-sensitive land-use planning, community preparedness, and resilience through targeted grants. It addresses multiple hazards including earthquakes, floods, landslides, fires, and disease outbreaks, aiming to improve national preparedness and municipal resilience.
